pages.text: Lord Souls forge legendary weapons from Soulslike Weaponry: the Moonlight Greatsword, the Dragonslayer Swordspear and many more. JEI shows the recipes.$(br2)They have their own keys: $(l)J$() parry, $(l)I$() weapon ability, $(l),$() swap a trick weapon's form, $(l).$() gather summoned souls.
